entries.name: npm
entries.summary: The package manager bundled with Node.js
entries.rule: Use npm for every install and script, and commit package-lock.json. Never run pnpm or yarn.
entries.why: Mixing package managers creates conflicting lockfiles.

entries.name: pnpm
entries.summary: Fast, disk-efficient package manager for Node.js
entries.rule: Use pnpm for every install and script. Never run npm or yarn.
entries.why: Mixing package managers creates conflicting lockfiles.

entries.name: uv
entries.summary: Fast package and project manager for Python
entries.rule: Add dependencies with `uv add` and run scripts and tools with `uv run`. Commit uv.lock and never edit it by hand. Never run pip install.
entries.why: pip bypasses uv.lock, so installs stop being reproducible.
